title: Apple Event September 2022: Apple Watch Ultra summary slide
lede: A light summary slide for Apple Watch Ultra in which one product color, safety orange, carries every key figure across pale grey tiles.
summary: Pale grey rounded tiles and black-and-white photo tiles with large orange figures, around a central watch. September 2022.

source.label: Apple Summary Slides (fan archive): Apple Event September 2022

evidence.note: Inspected the 1920 × 1080 WebP `[Apple Event September 2022]-[Apple Watch]-[Apple Watch Ultra].webp` from the fan archive [Apple Summary Slides](https://apple-summary-slides.vercel.app/events/apple-event-september-2022) (Ricky Zhang), which says that all images are screenshots of Apple event videos. Not stored.

styles.note: Clear: rounded tonal tiles of many sizes with one fact each, and one accent color for the figures.

context: Apple introduced Apple Watch Ultra at its event on 7 September 2022, the same event as the [iPhone 14 Pro slide](ref:apple-event-2022-iphone-14-pro-summary-slide).
observed: Pale grey tiles with large rounded corners sit on an off-white ground with narrow even gutters. About twenty tiles range from small pills (“ECG”, “LTE”, “Blood oxygen”) to a tall central tile with three views of the watch.
Key figures and words are set very large in bold orange: “60 hrs battery life”, “GPS”, “2000 nits”, “EN13319”. Labels are small and black.
Four tiles are black-and-white photographs (mountains, divers, a storm) with the orange figure set over the photo.
“WR100” and “MIL-STD 810” are set in a monospaced face, in blue and in black with orange.
Product photos of the watch and its bands are cropped by the tile edges.
interpretation: The slide shows how the look takes a brand accent: the tiles stay neutral, and one product color marks every figure. The black-and-white photo tiles keep the accent the only color on the slide.
borrow: Choose one accent from the product and use it only for figures and key words.
Desaturate photo tiles so that the accent figure on them stays the strongest color.

rights.statement: Frame of an Apple event video; copyrighted by Apple Inc. The fan archive states “All rights reserved by Apple Inc.” No image is stored here.
